feat: dynamic language selection and RFC5780 testing state

Refactor language settings to auto-discover available languages from
embedded resources instead of hardcoded ComboBox items. Add Language
property to Config for persistence. Track IsTesting state in
RFC5780ViewModel to disable transport type switching during tests.

🤖 Fully implemented by Claude (Opus 4.6).

fix: Handle ReactiveCommand exceptions via UI notifications instead of crashing (#298)

Co-authored-by: openai-code-agent[bot] <242516109+Codex@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Bruce Wayne <admin@bige0.com>

refactor: split StunClientAppService into RFC-specific services

Replace monolithic StunClientAppService with dedicated Rfc3489AppService
and Rfc5780AppService behind interfaces. Move Config properties into
SettingsViewModel and introduce StunTestInput DTO for cleaner separation.

Co-authored-by: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>

refactor: extract Avalonia views module and centralize STUN input validation

- rename UI project to NatTypeTester.Views and bootstrap NatTypeTesterViewsModule from desktop
- switch views to compiled bindings and code-behind localization bindings
- add NotificationExceptionHandler to show reactive/validation errors in UI notifications
- convert StunTestInput to a validatable DTO with LocalEndPoint and simplify RFC service APIs
- simplify RFC view models with snapshot fields and command-driven IsTesting state

refactor: introduce persistent JSON config and consolidate STUN test logic

Add NatTypeTester.Configuration module for JSON-based app settings
persistence (AppData/config.json) with atomic writes and default-value
pruning. Extract StunTestInputResolver to deduplicate DNS resolution,
proxy setup, and server parsing across RFC3489/RFC5780 services. Replace
reflection-based culture discovery with MSBuild-generated SupportedCultures.
Add proper IDisposable/CompositeDisposable to ViewModelBase and reactive
auto-save pipelines for settings and STUN server selection.

feat: add STUN server list management and notification service abstraction

- Add/delete STUN servers from UI with reactive commands
- Load STUN server list from URL or file path with proxy support
- Extract INotificationService to decouple ViewModels from Avalonia
- Debounce config saves in AppConfigManager with version tracking
- Dispose reactive commands properly across all ViewModels
fix: set ApplicationIcon to embed icon in published exe

Co-authored-by: renovate[bot] <29139614+renovate[bot]@users.noreply.github.com>

chore: use MinVer to derive version from git tags

Replace hardcoded Version properties in Desktop and STUN csproj files
with MinVer auto-versioning. Add fetch-depth: 0 to CI checkout steps
so MinVer can access git history.
chore: disable separate major/minor PRs for ReactiveUI in Renovate

chore: optimize CI workflow

- Use NuGet trusted publishing (OIDC) via NuGet/login action

- Auto-detect prerelease from tag name instead of hardcoding

- Replace pwsh scripts with bash on Ubuntu runners

chore(deps): update reactiveui (#303)

* chore: migrate code for ReactiveUI 23 and Splat 19

- RxApp.DefaultExceptionHandler → RxState.DefaultExceptionHandler
- RxApp.MainThreadScheduler → RxSchedulers.MainThreadScheduler
- Locator.Current → AppLocator.Current
- Locator.CurrentMutable → AppLocator.CurrentMutable
- Configure custom exception handler via ReactiveUIBuilder.WithExceptionHandler

chore: optimize CI workflow and update TUnit to 1.18.9

refactor: decouple services from UI layer and improve architecture

Move service interfaces (INotificationService, ILauncherService) to Application.Contracts
and AppNotificationType to Domain.Shared. Replace Process.Start with ILauncherService
using Avalonia's TopLevel.Launcher. Make NotificationService self-contained by managing
its own WindowNotificationManager. Add ObservableExtensions (CatchDefault, WhenActivatedAsync)
to reduce boilerplate. Remove Nito.AsyncEx dependency in favor of reactive activation.

chore(deps): bump ABP packages to 10.1.1

Update centralized ABP package versions to 10.1.1 to keep dependencies aligned and pick up latest patch fixes.
Fix config directory launch and move exception handler initialization

refactor: reorganize views namespaces and android signing config

- move NotificationExceptionHandler and TopLevelHelper into Infrastructure namespace\n- move ObservableStringLocalizer into Localization namespace\n- move AndroidUseApkSigner from CI args into project properties
refactor: replace contract assertions with guard clauses
refactor: reorganize ViewModels extensions and services
refactor(views): switch to system Fluent brushes and local spacing styles

feat: add option to skip TLS/DTLS certificate validation

Add a SkipCertificateValidation setting to bypass certificate checks
for TLS, DTLS, and TLS-over-SOCKS5 transports. Include Android-specific
root certificate validation workaround for DTLS. Rename Proxy tab to
Network.
refactor(stun): remove Android certificate validation workaround

build(console): exclude XML files from publish output
feat(console): add Spectre.Console rich output and localize CLI strings

feat: Use SkiaSharp 3 prelinked custom app host (#312)

refactor(stun): extract NAT discovery logic into pure state machines

Separate protocol state machines from I/O in STUN clients, enabling
independent unit testing of NAT type and behavior discovery logic.
feat(rfc5780): add individual test execution and cancel support

docs(stun): add XML documentation comments to all public members

Remove NoWarn CS1591 suppression and add XML doc comments to all public
types and members across 42 files. Replace per-project XML file
exclusion targets with PublishReferencesDocumentationFiles property in
Directory.Build.props.

refactor(slnx): organize projects into subfolders and normalize paths

Categorize entry points (Android/Console/Desktop) into /src/EntryPoints/,
STUN into /src/Libraries/, and normalize all paths to forward slashes.

chore(deps): update app dependencies

Upgrade Avalonia, ReactiveUI, ABP, TUnit, and supporting packages.

Share Avalonia app builder setup across desktop and Android.

Tighten STUN TLS/DTLS disposal and Span/Memory slicing.

refactor(app): replace ABP with Microsoft DI

- migrate configuration and localization to lightweight options and source-generated resources
- split settings concerns into focused view models and modernize desktop, Android, and console startup
- update dependencies, CI actions, and README diagrams
refactor(viewmodels): centralize polling and time access
build: enforce code style during builds
build: update AppHost and TUnit packages

build(deps): migrate to ReactiveUI 24 primitives

Adopt the lighter default APIs without System.Reactive, replace the DynamicData-backed STUN server list, and update related dependency automation.
build(deps): update ReactiveUI Avalonia and Splat.Serilog
ci: skip format and test jobs for renovate pull requests

refactor: resolve local end points via Application-layer DI

Move local end point enumeration from a ViewModels static class to an ILocalEndPointProvider (Application.Contracts) with a Singleton implementation (Application), injected through AppLocator. ComboBoxes now bind to the dynamic list instead of hardcoded items.

build: modernize AOT publishing and CI coverage

Enable NativeAOT for desktop and console apps, adopt StaticLink.Avalonia with SkiaSharp 4, and update stable dependencies.

Use source-generated ReactiveUI bindings, scope upstream trim warnings, prune transitive analyzers, refresh STUN endpoints, and expand the native CI matrix.

ci: fix Linux NativeAOT builds

Install libfontconfig-dev for Linux desktop targets and let every cross-platform build matrix entry complete independently.
chore: refresh and prioritize default STUN servers

build: update dependencies and enable reproducible builds

Adapt DTLS client creation to forward cancellation, share STUN server test data, and tighten XOR-mapped address assertions.
build: exclude debug symbols from publish output
